root_sharing.custody: Inspector owns at most one completed native observation plus bounded single-flight fullscan. Fullscan retains original scan-start issued and expiry<=issued+5s; full exact pinned module/AppDir member hashing remains unchanged. Retain exact config/boot/firewall/Xpra process PIDFD-start/invocation/unit/executable/argv/listener/root-owned readonly tree+manifest custody joins privately. No cached caller assertion.
root_sharing.per_request: Authenticate current gateway IPC peer; independently reread config/boot, live PIDFD/start/invocation/cgroup/UID, unit/executable/argv/listener/firewall identity and readonly AppDir/manifest root custody. Match retained observation key. Each nonce response shares only the original live native digest/timestamps. No renewed/restamped scan time, no ingress/JWT/session/principal cache.
root_sharing.invalidation: Expiry, mutation, mismatch or any check failure invalidates retained observation. Fullscan anew under existing bounded request budget or deny; never return stale evidence. Waiters may share a successful fullscan only while its original remaining time and their original request deadline remain live. Bound queue/wait/output; cancellation cannot publish partial/late result. Failed refresh does not leave previous proof usable.
root_sharing.security: Root-owned read-only full member custody remains required; changes cannot be ignored until indefinitely cached refresh. No skip of initial/full-on-expiry hash walk. No additional TTL, broader handler or effect authority.

consumer: StageXpraUnitReadback.verify returns typed observation. StageGatewayPolicySessionAdapter retains that exact observation and calls verify_current before response, connector I/O and watchdog.
